status: Recessed fit prototype; camera-view clearance and physical validation pending

parts.name: carrier
parts.supports: Supports required under rear bridge, track roofs and jaw ledges. Keep slider channel support accessible from open left end; remove fully.

parts.name: sliding_jaw
parts.supports: Outer rail face toward bed. Supports required under tongue, rear ledge and hooks. Protect sliding faces when removing support.

parts.name: actuator_bracket
parts.supports: Broad outside plate toward bed. Support first fairlead, pivot ears and return hooks; remove through open sides.

parts.name: rocker
parts.supports: Contact bore vertical. Support offset arm and pivot boss; keep supports out of threaded bore.

parts.name: pivot_key
parts.supports: Large head toward bed; support cross-lug. Check layer adhesion and quarter-turn retention.

parts.name: thumb_screw
parts.supports: Head on bed; no support in threads. Fit trial first; do not force.

parts.name: thumb_nut
parts.supports: Flat on bed; no supports. Fit trial first.

parts.name: string_guide
parts.supports: Saddle end on bed; support eye underside/bridge if slicer requests.
